name: Walking Step and Collect
notes: Practice variant for continuous Argentine tango sequences (2026-11-18): a 50 cm lead-left/follow-right walk, then collect the free feet on a separate Q without changing weight. The shorter walk keeps the default full-leg capsules clear; the original 60 cm open Walking Step remains available unchanged. Both Q counts are explicit: finish closed on lead left/follow right, ready for Side Step and Collect or a Weight Change. No figure skips, crossing flags, body offsets, solver changes or altered tolerances. Provisional collection timing and dimensions for subjective review.
